column1: # Functions where fcheck says DIFFERS and the C is not the cause (tools/fcheck_gate.py turns that into "unchecked" with the reason).
# name<TAB>reason. Only for a difference shown to come from the harness or from the host having no hardware to act on.

column2: the retail assembly of this very function, pasted in as the candidate, gets the identical DIFFERS (the first outside-memory event of the run differs before the function's own code matters), so the harness cannot compare it; the C was read against the assembly instruction for instruction (2026-10-18)

FlushCache is one syscall that writes back or invalidates the EE caches; the host has no caches to flush, so the port's C does nothing on purpose (libraries.tsv: "nothing to flush"), and C cannot make a syscall
